findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator cannot paginate datetime fields
findings.body: The audit log endpoint uses this paginator with `order_by=-datetime`, so `self.key` is `datetime` and `get_item_key` receives a `datetime` object. It then calls `math.floor` or `math.ceil` on that datetime, which raises `TypeError` because datetime is not a real number. `DateTimePaginator` handles this by converting to a timestamp with `strftime('%s.%f') * multiplier`, but this class does not. Even if the key conversion were fixed, `value_from_cursor` returns the raw cursor value instead of converting it back to a datetime, so `build_queryset` would compare the datetime column with an integer. Consequence: any non-empty audit log request with `optimized_pagination=true` fails with a 500.

findings.title: Negative offset slicing is not supported by Django QuerySet
findings.body: When `enable_advanced_features` is true and `cursor.offset < 0`, the code sets `start_offset = cursor.offset` and evaluates `queryset[start_offset:stop]`. Django QuerySet slicing does not support negative indices; the SQL compiler raises `AssertionError: Negative indexing is not supported`. The comment claims the ORM handles negative slicing automatically, but it does not. Since `Cursor.from_string` accepts negative offsets from API cursor strings, an authorized request with a crafted negative cursor and `optimized_pagination=true` will produce a 500, so the advertised negative-offset feature is broken.

findings.title: Eviction can remove the root/segment span from a segment
findings.body: The script trims the sorted set to 1000 members with `zpopmin(set_key, span_count - 1000)`. `zpopmin` removes members with the smallest `end_timestamp_precise` scores and makes no exception for the segment root span. A root span can have one of the smallest end timestamps, for example when async child spans outlive the root span or multiple spans share the same timestamp. The current root span can also be inserted and immediately popped in the same script call. If the root span is dropped, the buffered segment is later flushed without its root span, yet the `has_root_span` flag may still be set because it is based on the HRS key or current `is_root_span` and is not cleared when the root payload is removed. Downstream receives a malformed segment whose `segment_id` no longer appears as a span.

findings.title: ZUNIONSTORE default SUM corrupts scores on duplicate payloads
findings.body: Both `zunionstore` calls use Redis's default aggregate SUM. If the same payload member already exists in the destination and source, for example when Kafka at-least-once delivery reprocesses the same span, its score is added to itself and `end_timestamp_precise` becomes roughly doubled. The score no longer represents the span's end time, which breaks the eviction order used by `zpopmin` and can cause the wrong spans to be evicted. The operation should be made idempotent for score preservation, such as using `AGGREGATE MIN` or another strategy.

findings.title: Redirect traversal limit reduced from 10000 to 1000
findings.body: The script now follows parent redirects only through `i = 0..1000`. If a segment tree has more than 1000 redirect levels, the loop exits without reaching the canonical root, but the script still writes `hset(main_redirect_key, span_id, set_span_id)` using the last intermediate ID. This can join the span to the wrong segment or split a segment that the previous 10000-iteration limit would have handled. If the limit is intentional for performance, the truncation case should be handled explicitly rather than writing a potentially incorrect redirect.

findings.title: No test covers the new eviction behavior
findings.body: The new insertion-time eviction logic in `add-buffer.lua` is not covered by tests. Existing buffer tests insert only a handful of spans, so they cannot catch regressions where `zpopmin` drops the root span, evicts the wrong spans, or the hardcoded limit diverges from `max_segment_spans`. A test that inserts more than 1000 spans and asserts the root span is preserved and the segment is capped correctly is needed.
